page.title: My signature
page.intro: You need a .p12 or .pfx file with a private key — it is issued by a certification authority or your IT department
page.expired: The certificate has expired — upload a new one
page.deleteText: You will not be able to sign PDFs until you upload a new certificate.

dialog.title: Sign PDF
dialog.noCertificates: No valid GOST certificates — install a certificate in CryptoPro
dialog.confirmInPlugin: Confirm the signature in the CryptoPro window if it appears
dialog.authenticityNote: Certificate authenticity is checked by a signature verification service (for example, Gosuslugi)
dialog.unavailableText: Install <plugin>CryptoPro CAdES Browser plug-in</plugin> (with the browser extension) and <csp>CryptoPro CSP</csp>. When the browser asks, allow the site to access the plug-in, then reload the page.

cades.title: CryptoPro
cades.intro: GOST signing requires CryptoPro CSP, CryptoPro CAdES Browser plug-in and a GOST certificate on this computer.
cades.versions: CryptoPro CAdES Browser plug-in {{plugin}}, CryptoPro CSP {{csp}}
cades.unavailable: CryptoPro CAdES Browser plug-in or CryptoPro CSP not found
cades.certificateNotFound: Certificate not found in the “Personal” store
cades.cancelled: Signing was cancelled by the user
cades.tsaUnavailable: Timestamp service unavailable — try again later
